Final · Fri, Nov 6 · Los Angeles

Trail Blazers 118Lakers 124

Luka 53, Lakers stay perfect this week. Portland hit 19 threes and led at the half. Luka Dončić answered with 53, and 24 Blazers turnovers did the rest.

Three things that decided it

1Luka got to the line all night53 points on 17-of-33 shooting and 14-of-18 free throws.
2The third quarter flipped itThe Lakers won the third 34–15 to turn a 60–53 halftime deficit into a 12-point lead.
3Turnovers beat threesPortland made 19 threes but turned it over 24 times. The Lakers scored 28 points off them.
